summary: Boxlight Corp filed an 8-K/A amending its October 6, 2026 report on Series D and Series E preferred stock agreements. The amendment discloses a Revised Consent, Waiver and Ratification executed October 9, 2026 with Series D majority holders and J.J. Astor Co., effective September 30, 2026, replacing the original consent. It narrows MFN waivers, consents to Series E documents, and adds voting-rights acknowledgments. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or similar special situation is present; this is a routine contractual amendment and rights modification filing.
